nodeUrl.label: Imajin Node URL
nodeUrl.help: URL of the Imajin node to connect to (e.g. https://jin.imajin.ai)

did.label: Agent DID
did.help: The agent's decentralized identifier on the Imajin network

keypairPath.label: Keypair Path
keypairPath.help: Path to the Ed25519 keypair JSON file for signing

actAs.label: Default Acting-For DID
actAs.help: Default principal the agent acts on behalf of (X-Acting-For). Delegated writes (media/attest/transact/chat) default to this DID unless a call passes an explicit onBehalfOf. The agent must have role:agent membership on this DID.

attestation.serviceUrl.label: Attestation Service URL
attestation.serviceUrl.help: Base URL of the Imajin kernel's internal attestations endpoint. Defaults to nodeUrl when omitted.

attestation.internalApiKey.label: Attestation Internal API Key
attestation.internalApiKey.help: Bearer token for POST /auth/api/attestations/internal. Falls back to the ATTESTATION_INTERNAL_API_KEY env var when omitted.

wsNotifications.hookToken.label: Wake Hook Token
wsNotifications.hookToken.help: Bearer token for the Gateway's POST /hooks/agent (#18), matching that Gateway's hooks.token. Accepts a plain string or a SecretRef object ({ source, provider, id }, #20) resolved via the plugin SDK — recommended so the same secrets-store entry backs both this plugin and the Gateway's hooks.token. Falls back to the IMAJIN_WAKE_HOOK_TOKEN env var when omitted or unresolvable. Never logged.

approvalBridge.pinnedApproverPublicKeyHe.label: Approval Bridge: Pinned Approver Public Key
approvalBridge.pinnedApproverPublicKeyHe.help: Ed25519 public key (hex) of the sole trusted human approver for OpenClaw gateway approval decisions signed on /jin (#1816). Channel/WS auth alone never resolves an approval — only a signature from this key does.

inferProxyBaseUrl.label: Imajin Model Provider: Inference Proxy Base URL
inferProxyBaseUrl.help: Base URL of the local kernel inference proxy the `imajin` OpenClaw model provider discovers its catalog from (#36). Default http://127.0.0.1:8787/openai/v1. Effective models endpoint is `<this>/models`; healthz is probed at the proxy root.

mcpUrl.label: Kernel MCP Passthrough URL
mcpUrl.help: Local passthrough `/mcp` endpoint that fronts the kernel's MCP tools (google_*, calendar, drive; #50). Default: the inference proxy root + /mcp (http://127.0.0.1:8787/mcp). imajin_status probes it and checks that an `mcp.servers` entry points at it (streamable-http, NO headers — the proxy mints the app token). Register it (send/write tools excluded by default; to enable one, remove its glob or name from --exclude) with: openclaw mcp add imajin --url http://127.0.0.1:8787/mcp --transport streamable-http --exclude 'google_*_send*,google_*_create*,google_*_update*,google_*_delete*,google_*_trash*,google_*_untrash*,google_*_modify*,google_*_move*,google_*_copy*,google_*_share*,google_*_insert*,google_*_patch*,google_*_draft*,google_*_reply*,google_*_forward*,google_*_archive*,google_*_label*,google_*_upload*,google_*_import*,google_*_append*,google_*_set*,google_*_add*,google_*_remove*,google_*_cancel*,google_*_accept*,google_*_decline*,google_*_watch*,google_*_stop*,google_*_write*'

modelDiscovery.refreshIntervalMs.label: Imajin Model Provider: Discovery Refresh Interval (ms)
modelDiscovery.refreshIntervalMs.help: How often the plugin re-runs model discovery against the kernel's GET /infer/v1/models/usable (#55), in addition to the run at plugin start and the WS-driven refresh. Default 300000 (5 min); values below 10000 are raised to 10000; 0 disables the periodic refresh (start-up discovery still runs).

modelDiscovery.modelsPath.label: Imajin Model Provider: Kernel Models Path
modelDiscovery.modelsPath.help: Kernel route (relative to nodeUrl) the catalog is discovered from. Default /infer/v1/models/usable — the OpenAI-shaped list of the principal's usable brains (imajin-ai#2201). Note /infer/v1/models is the Anthropic model-catalog passthrough, not this list.

loops.enabled.label: Loop Lifecycle Events: Enabled
loops.enabled.help: Publish signed loop.started/progress/blocked/finished events for primary sessions, subagents, cron automations and keepers to the kernel loops rail (POST /api/loops, #46). Default on when nodeUrl + did + keypairPath are configured; set false to opt out. Lifecycle metadata only — never transcript content. When actAs names a principal other than the agent DID, the kernel requires an active loops:publish delegation grant from that principal.

loops.keeperJobs.label: Loop Lifecycle Events: Keeper Cron Jobs
loops.keeperJobs.help: Cron jobs (matched on job id, name or declarationKey) to publish as kind openclaw.keeper instead of openclaw.automation. Jobs named keeper, keeper:*, keeper-*, keeper_* or keeper/* are always keepers.

sessionCommands.enabled.label: Session Commands: Enabled
sessionCommands.enabled.help: Accept signed, DID-addressed session commands (session.send/approve/deny/abort/spawn) over the kernel WebSocket, execute them against the local gateway, and attest every outcome as a signed loop.session.* event (#51). Off by default; requires did + keypairPath + sessionCommands.kernelPublicKeyHex. See docs/session-commands.md.

sessionCommands.kernelPublicKeyHex.label: Session Commands: Pinned Kernel Public Key
sessionCommands.kernelPublicKeyHex.help: Ed25519 public key (hex) of the kernel's session-command signer. The only key whose grant is accepted; channel/WS auth alone never executes a command.

sessionCommands.kernelDid.label: Session Commands: Kernel DID
sessionCommands.kernelDid.help: Optional. When set, a command's issuer must equal this DID in addition to the pinned key.

sessionCommands.requirePrincipalCounters.label: Session Commands: Require Principal Countersignature
sessionCommands.requirePrincipalCounters.help: Default true: a command must also carry the principal's own signature (wish-and-grant, imajin-ai#2084), verified against the principal's registered key. false skips only this check; the kernel grant and serviceOf binding are always required.

approvals.enabled.label: Gateway Approvals Bridge: Enabled
approvals.enabled.help: Publish staged Gateway system-agent proposals (restart / config mutation) to the kernel and apply signed operator decisions from /jin back to the Gateway (#24). Off by default; requires did + keypairPath + operatorDid + notifyWebhookSecret.

approvals.operatorDid.label: Gateway Approvals Bridge: Operator DID
approvals.operatorDid.help: The Imajin DID of the human operator who decides proposals on /jin. The kernel notification is addressed to this DID and the returned operator.approval.decided event is only ever trusted when every identity field matches it exactly.

approvals.sources.label: Gateway Approvals Bridge: Sources
approvals.sources.help: Which approval sources to drive: "system-agent" (OpenClaw gateway restart / config-mutation proposals, #33) and/or "skill-workshop" (pending Skill Workshop skill proposals, #33) are on by default. "imajin-catalog" (opt-in per-model gating for newly discovered imajin/* models, #36 — an alternative to the one-time `imajin/*` modelPolicy.allow wildcard) and "gateway-exec" (OpenClaw host-exec approvals filed to the kernel as kind gateway-exec:command, #38) are opt-in ONLY — neither is ever enabled unless listed here explicitly, even when this array is otherwise omitted; gateway-exec grants remote-execution-grade operator.approvals authority over live host-exec approvals. ORDERING NOTE: land gateway-exec + ima-jin/imajin-ai#2221 before flipping the ssh exec policy from deny to ask (askFallback: deny) — flipping first routes prompts to the legacy Telegram /approve path this source replaces. A source left out of this list neither lists nor subscribes.

approvals.gatewayToken.label: Gateway Approvals Bridge: Gateway Token
approvals.gatewayToken.help: Optional bearer override for the plugin's own loopback OpenClaw Gateway operator connection (scopes: ["operator.approvals"]). Accepts a plain string or a SecretRef object ({source, provider, id}), resolved via the plugin SDK. When omitted, Gateway auth is resolved automatically from the host's own gateway config (the same mechanism the existing approvalBridge feature already relies on). Never logged.

approvals.notifyWebhookSecret.label: Gateway Approvals Bridge: Kernel Notify Webhook Secret
approvals.notifyWebhookSecret.help: Bearer value for the kernel's POST /notify/api/send x-webhook-secret header (that kernel's NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_SECRET). Accepts a plain string or a SecretRef object, resolved via the plugin SDK. Falls back to the IMAJIN_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_SECRET env var when omitted. Required for the bridge to publish anything. Never logged.

approvals.skillWorkshop.operatorScopes.label: Gateway Approvals Bridge: Skill Workshop Operator Scopes
approvals.skillWorkshop.operatorScopes.help: Operator scopes (#35) to request on the skill-workshop source's OWN loopback Gateway connection, instead of the SDK's fixed operator.approvals-only default (insufficient for skills.proposals.list/apply/reject on a strict/token-mode gateway). Default (omitted or []): ["operator.read", "operator.admin"], exactly what skills.proposals.list/apply/reject require; set ["operator.approvals"] to opt out of the broader authority. This grants exactly what those RPCs require — this plugin then applies proposals with that authority, since it is the component that does so. Only known operator scopes (operator.read, operator.admin, operator.approvals, operator.write) are accepted; an unrecognized entry fails plugin startup with a clear error. See docs/approvals-bridge.md.

approvals.requireOperatorCountersignatur.label: Gateway Approvals Bridge: Require Operator Countersignature
approvals.requireOperatorCountersignatur.help: Mirrors the kernel's OPERATOR_COUNTERSIGN_REQUIRED (#44, ima-jin/imajin-ai#2082). Default false: a decision missing operatorSignature is still applied (unchanged v1 behavior); any operatorSignature that IS supplied is ALWAYS verified directly against the operator DID's registered public key regardless of this flag. true: a decision (including a withdrawal) lacking a valid operatorSignature is rejected before it ever reaches a source. See README 'Operator countersignature' for the recommended rollout order.

approvals.loopBlockSweepIntervalMs.label: Gateway Approvals Bridge: Stale Loop-Block Sweep Interval (ms)
approvals.loopBlockSweepIntervalMs.help: How often the bridge re-checks the approvals it holds a loop block for (#66), clearing the block of any approval settled outside /jin (gateway UI / CLI) that has no expiry. Default 60000 (1 min); values below 5000 are raised to 5000; 0 disables the sweep. Observe-only: a failing check is logged and dropped.

wsNotifications.stateDir.label: Notification State Directory
wsNotifications.stateDir.help: Directory for the ack-dedup LRU and pending-wake persistence files (#26). Defaults to a directory colocated with keypairPath.

wsNotifications.reportTo.label: Wake Report Sessions
wsNotifications.reportTo.help: Session keys (e.g. agent:main:telegram:direct:<id>) the wake worker session discloses to (#47). After a wake turn completes in the wake session, its final assistant output — or 'no output' plus the Warp run state — is forwarded once per wake batch to each key, wrapped as an informational report from warp-events (not a wake). Default empty = no reports. Invalid keys are logged once and ignored.

wsNotifications.wakeOwedMaxAgeMs.label: Owed Wake Max Age (ms)
wsNotifications.wakeOwedMaxAgeMs.help: Age bound for a persisted 'wake owed' marker replayed at startup (#30). A marker older than this is dropped — already durably injected — instead of firing a stale wake. Default 3600000 (1h).

actAs.description: Default acting-for DID (X-Acting-For). Delegated writes default to this principal unless onBehalfOf is passed explicitly.

inferProxyBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the local kernel inference proxy the imajin OpenClaw model provider discovers its catalog from (#36). Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:8787/openai/v1. The effective model-list endpoint is `<this>/models` (OpenAI list shape, ima-jin/imajin-ai#2201); `GET /healthz` is probed at the proxy root.

mcpUrl.description: Local passthrough /mcp endpoint for the kernel's MCP tools (#50). Defaults to the inferProxyBaseUrl root + /mcp. Used only by imajin_status (probe + registration check); the plugin never sends credentials to it.

modelDiscovery.description: Model discovery for the imajin OpenClaw model provider (#55): GET <nodeUrl><modelsPath> with the agent's DID session at plugin start and every refreshIntervalMs.

refreshIntervalMs.description: Periodic re-discovery interval in ms. Default 300000 (5 min). Values below 10000 are raised to 10000. 0 disables the periodic refresh; discovery still runs at plugin start and on kernel connector notifications.

modelsPath.description: Kernel route (relative to nodeUrl) to discover against. Default /infer/v1/models/usable.

loops.description: Loop lifecycle publisher (#46): signed loop.* events to the kernel loops rail (imajin-ai#2295). Lifecycle metadata only.

enabled.description: Explicit opt-out. Defaults to true when nodeUrl + did + keypairPath are configured.

keeperJobs.description: Cron jobs (job id, name or declarationKey) published as openclaw.keeper rather than openclaw.automation.

wsNotifications.description: Configure which WS notification scopes trigger agent session injection (#1672)

injectScopes.description: Notification scopes that trigger agent wake-up. Include every terminal Warp run scope (warp.run.completed, warp.run.failed, warp.run.timeout) so failed and timed-out runs reach the agent session.

targetSession.description: Session key to inject notifications into

wakeSessionKey.description: Session key to wake with a real agent turn via the Gateway's POST /hooks/agent (#18). Defaults to targetSession.

wakeSettleMs.description: Leading-edge settle window for Warp wake turns, in ms (#25). The first qualifying notification in an idle window fires its own wake after this delay; anything joining before it fires batches into that same leading wake. Default 10000 (10s).

wakeCoalesceMs.description: Trailing coalesce window for Warp wake turns, in ms, measured from the leading wake (#25). Any notification arriving in this window after the leading wake fires batches into ONE follow-up wake at the window's end. Default 30000 (30s, was 300000/5min).

wakeOwedMaxAgeMs.description: Age bound, in ms, for a persisted 'wake owed' marker replayed at startup (#30). A marker older than this is dropped instead of firing a stale wake — its frames already reached the agent via the durable system-event queue — and logged as expired. Default 3600000 (1h).

hookToken.description: Bearer token for the Gateway's POST /hooks/agent, matching that Gateway's hooks.token. Accepts a plain string or a SecretRef object (#20), resolved once via the plugin SDK. Falls back to the IMAJIN_WAKE_HOOK_TOKEN env var when omitted or unresolvable.

hooksPath.description: Gateway hooks base path (matching that Gateway's hooks.path). Default /hooks.

hookAgentId.description: Agent id to route the wake hook to (must be permitted by that Gateway's hooks.allowedAgentIds). Default main.

reportTo.description: Session keys (e.g. agent:main:telegram:direct:<id>) the wake worker session discloses to (#47). After a wake turn completes in the wake session, its final assistant output (or 'no output' plus the run state) is forwarded once per wake batch to each key as an informational report from warp-events — not a wake. Default empty = no reports. Entries are validated at runtime rather than by this schema: a malformed or unknown session key is logged once and ignored, never a startup failure.

stateDir.description: Directory for this injector's persisted state (#26): the ack-dedup LRU (notification-ack-dedup.json) and pending-wake markers (pending-wakes.json). Defaults to a directory colocated with keypairPath.

directSend.description: Direct channel ping via the OpenClaw CLI — deterministic, no model turn. Also the #14 fallback destination when the wake hook is disabled or unreachable.

cliPath.description: Absolute path to the openclaw CLI binary; default openclaw (PATH).

attestation.description: Configure the agent_end → agent.turn.usage attestation hook (#1843)

enabled.description: Explicit opt-out. Defaults to true when serviceUrl + internalApiKey both resolve.

serviceUrl.description: Base URL of the attestation service. Defaults to nodeUrl.

internalApiKey.description: Bearer token for POST /auth/api/attestations/internal. Falls back to the ATTESTATION_INTERNAL_API_KEY env var.

approvalBridge.description: Route OpenClaw gateway approval requests (exec elevation, Skill Workshop lifecycle) to /jin and resolve them from signed decisions (#1816). Requires did + keypairPath.

pinnedApproverPublicKeyHex.description: Ed25519 public key (hex) of the sole trusted human approver. A decision is resolved only when it carries a valid signature from this exact key, references the matching request id, and arrives before the request's expiry.

approvals.description: Gateway approvals bridge (#24): publish staged Gateway system-agent proposals to the kernel as operator.approval.requested, and apply signed operator.approval.decided decisions from /jin back to the Gateway's own approval store. Additive and off by default; requires did + keypairPath.

enabled.description: Explicit opt-in. Off unless true, even if the other approvals.* fields are set.

operatorDid.description: The operator's Imajin DID (did:imajin:...). The kernel notification is addressed to this DID; a decided event is only trusted when issuer/subject/decidedBy all equal it exactly.

sources.description: Which approval sources to drive (#33, #36, #38). Defaults to ["system-agent", "skill-workshop"] when omitted — "imajin-catalog" (#36, per-model gating for newly discovered imajin/* models) and "gateway-exec" (#38, grants remote-execution-grade operator.approvals authority over live OpenClaw host-exec approvals) are opt-in ONLY and never included in that default; list either explicitly to enable it. A source left out neither lists nor subscribes — no bridge-code changes are needed to add or remove a source.

gatewayToken.description: Optional bearer override for the plugin's own loopback Gateway operator connection. A plain string or a SecretRef object, resolved once via the plugin SDK. Optional: Gateway auth otherwise resolves automatically from the host's own gateway config.

notifyWebhookSecret.description: Bearer value for the kernel's POST /notify/api/send x-webhook-secret header. A plain string or a SecretRef object, resolved once via the plugin SDK. Falls back to the IMAJIN_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_SECRET env var. Required for the bridge to publish anything.

skillWorkshop.description: Skill Workshop source config (#35). No separate 'enabled' flag: whether the skill-workshop source runs at all is already governed by approvals.sources.

operatorScopes.description: Operator scopes to request on the skill-workshop source's own loopback Gateway connection (via createOperatorGatewayClient, #35), instead of the SDK's fixed ['operator.approvals']-only default client. Default (omitted or []) is ['operator.read', 'operator.admin'], exactly what skills.proposals.list/apply/reject require; set ['operator.approvals'] to opt out of the broader authority. An entry outside this enum fails plugin startup with a clear error rather than silently connecting with a scope the Gateway will reject.

loopBlockSweepIntervalMs.description: Stale loop-block sweep interval in ms (#66): how often the bridge re-checks, via getCurrent, the approvals it holds a loop block for and unblocks any no longer pending (e.g. settled in the gateway UI/CLI with no expiry). Default 60000. Values below 5000 are raised to 5000. 0 disables the sweep.

requireOperatorCountersignature.description: Mirrors the kernel's OPERATOR_COUNTERSIGN_REQUIRED (#44, ima-jin/imajin-ai#2082). Default false: a decision missing operatorSignature is still applied (unchanged v1 behavior); a supplied operatorSignature is ALWAYS verified against the operator DID's registered public key regardless of this flag. true: a decision (including a withdrawal) lacking a valid operatorSignature is rejected before it ever reaches a source.
